_metadata.description: Documentation, scope, and scenario boundary requirements for Quality Health.

requirements.title: Document Quality Health ownership boundary
requirements.description: Foundation docs define Quality Health as the static-quality authority, Code Facts as the discovery source, Test Genie as orchestrator, Tidiness Manager as maintainability owner, and Scenario Auditor as owner of remaining non-quality standards.

validation.notes: Review PRD.md, docs/concepts/ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/concepts/DOMAINS.md, and docs/internal/SEAMS.md for the ownership boundary.

requirements.title: Preserve Phase 0 rule-parity decisions
requirements.description: Scenario reference docs carry forward every migrated rule ID, existing rule behavior, protective comment requirement, finding shape, and autofix safety decision from the Phase 0 handoff.

validation.notes: Compare docs/reference/quality-contracts.md, docs/reference/finding-schema.md, and docs/reference/autofix.md to the user plan store quality-health-phase0 handoff.
